title: Matched two-seed anchor-preserving recent opponent geometric trial
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Current learned opponents can improve broad continued learning over nearly static historical loss-ranked pools; recency alone is not strength evidence.
material_change: Only pool strategy anchor-latest versus loss-kbest; same original connected2M parents, retained full state and training regimen.
